fields.name: room_id
fields.desc: room the NPC appears in (ItemWorld_RoomDataBase id; 1000 = generic, some values like 102 not in that table)

fields.name: char_id
fields.desc: class/character of the NPC: char.dat id (char offset 208; 2010 Prinny, 3500 Mil ...). 7524 and 9996..9999 are not in char.dat

fields.name: talk_id
fields.desc: message/script id (3060000/10/20/30 for commuting prinnies, 4500001.. innocents); 0 = none
